hinh_khoi.mo_ta: Many brick chimney stacks and pots were added on roofs. BEFORE has none. Cluster at the centre-right near the white spire.
Several chimney stacks were added on the right-hand roofs and skyline.
Chimneys were added on the left and mid-left roofs.
Dormer-like window pediments and cornice and string-course details were added on the facade of the central tan building. BEFORE has plain bands.
The prominent pale house left of centre has its triangular masonry gable repainted as a slate roof slope, making the roof appear hipped rather than gabled.
The large ochre house in the centre has its triangular brick gable replaced visually by a slate roof slope, changing the apparent roof form.
The pale house immediately behind the left side of the central ochre house has its masonry gable repainted as a hipped slate roof.
A chimney stack and pots have been added above the rear edge of the prominent left-centre house's roof.
A tall brick chimney stack has been added behind the roof immediately left of the large foreground brick gable.
A brick chimney with terracotta pots has been added to the small slate-roofed house right of centre.
Two substantial chimney stacks with pots have been added behind the roof of the prominent brick house on the right.
A broad brick chimney stack has been added behind the roof near the right foreground gable.
A tall chimney stack with pots has been added farther right, beside the foreground gable's rising edge.
Small projecting dormer-like roof windows have been introduced on the yellow house's roof right of centre; the corresponding BEFORE roof is plain.
Additional raised dormer-like details appear on the roof of the house immediately behind the yellow house.
Numerous small chimney stacks and pots have been added across the left background housing, changing individual roof silhouettes rather than merely their surface finish.
Additional chimney stacks and pots appear throughout the middle-distance housing between the cathedral and the right-hand foreground houses.
